`mcp_console` provides Python clients and model framework adapters for Console's persistent R, Python, and SQL workbench.

## Use the package

Start with [Use Console from Python](../PYTHON.md), or jump to a task:

- <span id="start-without-a-model"></span> [Call Console directly](../PYTHON.md#call-console-directly): install the client and make synchronous or asynchronous calls.
- <span id="add-a-model-framework"></span> [Choose a model integration](../PYTHON.md#choose-a-model-integration): select an adapter and its package extra.
- <span id="calls-and-dependencies"></span> [Drive send directly](../SEND_OPERATIONS.md) for call sequencing, or [Requirements](reference/Requirements.qmd) for dependency declarations.

## API reference

The [Python API reference](reference/index.qmd) documents arguments, return values, and complete integration examples.
See [MCPConsole](reference/MCPConsole.qmd) and [AsyncMCPConsole](reference/AsyncMCPConsole.qmd) for the clients, and [Requirements](reference/Requirements.qmd) for dependency declarations.

The shared [documentation](../README.md) covers language behavior, configuration, sandbox permissions, and recordings.
